attribution_limitations: The day 10 text values (AST 58, ALT 118, gamma-GT 81 U/L, total bilirubin 0.94 mg/dl) are merged with the Table 1 T10 days cells because both name day 10 and print the same values. The day 3 laboratory sentence states no time of its own (the On day 3 sentence names only fatigue and asthenia), and its values resemble the T3 days column (total bilirubin 2.4 versus 2.37 by rounding, direct bilirubin 1.95, gamma-GT 142), so they are kept as separate untimed items. The admission text values (CRP 1.9, white blood cells 9,150, neutrophils 68.8%) resemble the T0 days column, but the source does not label T0 as admission, so they are not merged.

Source conflict on the reference interval of the day 10 ALT value: the text prints normal value <33 U/L and Table 1 prints 10–30 for the same measurement. The merged item keeps the value without an interval and both interval sides are review_only.

Other text and Table 1 differences sit on items that are not identified as the same measurement: CRP normal value <0.5 in the admission text versus <0.06 in Table 1, and white blood cells printed /mm^(3) in the text versus cells/ml in Table 1. They are kept as printed on their own items without correction.
Table 1 prints the hemoglobin value at T7 days as 11,7 (comma) while every other cell uses a decimal point; it is kept textual and review-only.

The source spells "later cervical" for the swelling and lymphadenitis (probably lateral) and says "antistreptolysin title" (titer). Side is stated as left only in the presentation sentence and in the ultrasound sentence.

Figure 1 is an image-only timeline whose printed labels (for example day of discontinuation and of discharge) are pixel content; the text does not state the day ceftriaxone was suspended or any discharge date, so none is recorded as a fact.
